mechanic:break_mine.art_style: Mostly simulator_bright with blocky/voxel dirt (about 7/12); a few dark gritty or stylized 3D renders.
avoid: Busy scenes with no clear target
Flat dark icons with no readable subject
mechanic:break_mine.direction: Icon: close-up avatar swinging a pickaxe into a cracked, glowing egg or crystal, shards flying, bright blocky background. Thumbnail: underground cross-section with the avatar tunneling toward a big glowing prize, one short number badge.
do: Show the avatar mid-swing at one glowing breakable object
Make the target crack visibly with shards flying
Use a dirt/rock cross-section or cave frame to say 'dig'
Keep colours saturated with one hot glow (lava orange or crystal blue)

icon_patterns.pattern: Avatar actively hitting/drilling/digging the target (pickaxe, drill, shovel, hammer)
Glowing breakable object as hero item (lava egg, crystal, gem egg)
Bright saturated simulator colours with blocky textures
Dark/cave or night background

mechanic:break_mine.newcomer_shift: NEW games show tunnels and cave interiors, a shovel-in-hand first-person view, hourglass/limited-time badges and 'CHAPTER'/'UPDATE' banners.
mechanic:break_mine.summary: Leaders show a Roblox avatar mid-swing at a glowing egg, crystal or rock wall, with bright blocky worlds; newcomers lean on cave/underground scenes and update badges.
mechanic:break_mine.text_usage: Light: most icons have no text; a minority use rarity odds or huge numbers; newcomers add UPDATE/CHAPTER/+1 badges.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Cracked or glowing egg/crystal centered, avatar beside it
Underground dirt/rock cross-section framing
Big rarity/number text (1 in X, 9,000,000)

mechanic:collect_index.art_style: simulator_bright about 9/12; one stylized horror-cute leader and one realistic car scene.
mechanic:collect_index.direction: Icon: a glowing secret-rarity collectible filling the frame with a small 'SECRET' tag. Thumbnail: avatar grabbing it with a red arrow and a huge rainbow $/s number.
do: Make one rare collectible the hero, glowing
Add a 'SECRET' or $/s tag
Place the avatar reacting beside it
Use bright blue/green backgrounds

icon_patterns.pattern: Single hero collectible dominating the frame (egg, card, car, creature)
Bright saturated simulator background
Red arrow / 'YOU' callout
Money-per-second or rarity text

mechanic:collect_index.newcomer_shift: NEW games add giant $/s numbers ($999B/s), 'SECRET'/'MYTHIC' labels and dream-bubble framing.
mechanic:collect_index.summary: Collect games show one desirable collectible (egg, pet, car, creature) glowing next to an avatar, usually with a YOU arrow or $/s number.
mechanic:collect_index.text_usage: Short: 'YOU', 'SECRET', 'MYTHIC', or a $/s number; most leaders use no text.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Avatar reacting next to the collectible
Blocky/voxel creatures or eggs

mechanic:dice_cards.art_style: Mixed: simulator_bright for reveal games, anime splash art for card battlers.
avoid: Showing many small cards with no focus
mechanic:dice_cards.direction: Icon: first-person hands holding a glowing gold mystery card with a '?', sparkles, rainbow '$/s' number above. Thumbnail: shocked avatar beside an Ultra Rare card flipping open.
do: Show one glowing card or die held toward the camera
Add one huge odds or $/s number in rainbow gradient
Use a surprised face next to the reveal

icon_patterns.pattern: Hand holding the card/die/board close to camera
Huge rainbow or gold numbers (odds or $/s)
Glowing golden mystery card with '?'

mechanic:dice_cards.summary: Card/dice games sell the reveal: a glowing mystery card or a die held up close with huge rarity odds or money-per-second text.
mechanic:dice_cards.text_usage: Big rainbow-gradient numbers (1 in 9,342,584; $978,829/s) at the top edge.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Shocked avatar next to a glowing card reveal
Anime character art on the card

mechanic:forge_craft.art_style: simulator_bright majority; a few dark_gritty/anime fantasy leaders.
avoid: Dark scenes without a readable item
mechanic:forge_craft.direction: Icon: avatar hammering on an anvil with sparks, glowing finished item beside it. Thumbnail: split panel, crude item left, legendary glowing item right, red arrow and price pop-up.
do: Show a crude-to-legendary split with a red arrow
Make the crafted item glow (fire or purple magic)
Add one sell/price callout

icon_patterns.pattern: Glowing fiery or magic item as hero (sword, ring, drill, raft gun)
Red arrow showing transformation or target
Big $/s or wins numbers

mechanic:forge_craft.newcomer_shift: NEW games sell crafted items to NPCs: 'SOLD!'/'SELL' buttons with +$100m pop-ups.
mechanic:forge_craft.summary: Forge/craft games show the upgrade arc: a crude item turning into a glowing legendary one, with arrows and big numbers.
mechanic:forge_craft.text_usage: Numbers and short verbs: +1T, SOLD!, SELL, $382,847,837/s.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Before/after split (raft vs warship, hammer vs +1T sword)
Avatar holding or presenting the crafted item

mechanic:hit_swing.art_style: simulator_bright about 8/12; a couple of anime and stylized combat renders.
mechanic:hit_swing.direction: Icon: close-up impact of the hit with a stretched motion trail and shocked face. Thumbnail: object flying across the map along a curved arrow toward a giant distance number.
do: Freeze the exact impact moment with motion trails
Show the projectile's arc
Add one huge distance or level number

icon_patterns.pattern: Impact moment with motion lines/trails
Avatar with panicked or intense face
Bright sky/grass simulator backdrop

mechanic:hit_swing.newcomer_shift: NEW games use mass-object scenes (hills of golf balls), big red STOP buttons and lucky-block rarity reveals.
mechanic:hit_swing.summary: Hit/launch games freeze the moment of impact: a fist, kick, club or launcher with motion trails and flying objects.
mechanic:hit_swing.text_usage: Numbers and level counters, short shouted words (STOP, NOW!).

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Projectile arc or flight path shown
Big number or level text (level 6.5b, 1%, $/s)

mechanic:paint_create.art_style: simulator_bright and stylized mix; some realistic house/desert scenes.
avoid: Abstract art with no tool or result visible
mechanic:paint_create.direction: Icon: first-person tool spraying or painting, leaving a clean bright stripe through grime. Thumbnail: diagonal split, dull before vs vivid after, red arrow.
do: Show a tool mid-stroke leaving a clean/painted trail
Use a split before/after
Keep one short bold verb on the thumbnail

icon_patterns.pattern: Tool in use (brush, pressure washer, pencil, trowel)
Before/after or red arrow transformation
Bright cartoon colours

mechanic:paint_create.newcomer_shift: NEW games favour realistic-ish washing/building scenes (pressure washing a house, laying bricks) and hand-drawn line puzzles.
mechanic:paint_create.summary: Creative games show the transformation: messy to clean, blank to painted, with red arrows and a split frame.
mechanic:paint_create.text_usage: Short imperative title words in bold outlined type.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Split dirty/clean or plain/painted
Short bold title text (PAINT ANYTHING!, DRAW TO REUNITE!)

mechanic:plus_one_stat.art_style: simulator_bright dominates (about 10/12), classic studded Roblox avatars on blocky terrain.
avoid: Dark backgrounds that hide the +1 text
mechanic:plus_one_stat.direction: Icon: bacon-hair avatar mid-action with a glowing upgraded tool, 5 floating '+1' numbers, bright grass and sky. Thumbnail: split panel, weak start '+1' on the left vs huge '+1T' version on the right.
do: Scatter 4-6 bold white '+1' numbers around the avatar
Show the action itself mid-motion
Use a before/after split for the end-game power
Keep a bright green/blue blocky background

icon_patterns.pattern: Floating white '+1' numbers around the avatar
Bacon-hair or classic noob avatar as the subject
Bright sky blue + grass green blocky background
Glowing weapon/item showing upgrade

mechanic:plus_one_stat.newcomer_shift: NEW games push combat: guns, swords and soldiers with '+1' and '+1T' damage text, and split before/after panels.
mechanic:plus_one_stat.summary: Almost every game uses the classic bacon-hair avatar surrounded by floating '+1' text on a bright green/blue blocky world.
mechanic:plus_one_stat.text_usage: The '+1' itself is the main text, repeated 4-8 times in white with black outline; occasional 'WORLD 2' or '+1M/s' banners.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: '+1' text spray across the frame
Before/after split (weak vs strong, +1 vs +1T)
Avatar in motion doing the action (running, skipping, swinging)

mechanic:quiz_guess.art_style: Bright, flat cartoon composites: Roblox avatars pasted against 2D IP art or UI mockups (7/8). One is a cropped moody avatar close-up.
avoid: Cropped or ambiguous close-ups that don't say what you're guessing
Thumbnails with no visible question or choices
mechanic:quiz_guess.direction: Icon: a bold 'GUESS THE ___?' headline across the top, a head-scratching bacon-hair with red '?' marks, and the mystery object or answer choices big in the lower half on a bright blue sky. Thumbnail: the full quiz moment, with the question in outlined type, 3-4 options lined up with the last as a '?' box, and a red arrow pointing at the one to guess.
do: Write the question as the headline in chunky two-tone outlined type ('GUESS THE ___?') across the top third
Show a puzzled bacon-hair avatar with a hand on their head and two or three red '?' marks floating above
Lay the answer choices out clearly (3-5 swatches, cards or options), with one shown as a '?' box
Use a bright blue sky with cartoon clouds behind
Show the comparison or mystery object big enough to read at icon size (e.g. Earth vs a tiny avatar with a height ruler)

icon_patterns.pattern: Big question marks (red/white '?' over heads, '?' card, 'WHAT COLOR?!')
Answer choices visible (colour swatches, Guess Who board, song-player UI with play button, two album covers with checkmarks, row of coloured smileys)
The question as a bold outlined headline ('What Color?', 'WHAT COLOR?!', 'PARTY MODE! 4 PLAYERS', Thai title text)
Avatar in a thinking pose: hand on head or chin, puzzled face
Recognisable IP characters (Anya and Gojo, Gumball, real Thai music artists)

mechanic:quiz_guess.summary: Quiz/guess games put the question on the art: a headline like 'What Color?', a puzzled Roblox avatar surrounded by '?' marks, and the answer choices laid out in view, often with recognisable IP characters.
mechanic:quiz_guess.text_usage: Heaviest text of any niche. The question itself is the headline (4/8), in chunky outlined two-tone type, plus UI labels (Easy-Impossible, 0.1s, '1.8m') and question marks used as text.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Headline question text in thick outlined yellow/red/blue type ('GUESS THE SIZE', 'What Color?', 'WHAT COLOR?!', Thai title)
Puzzled or thinking character with '?' marks (headphone bacon, chin-hand cartoon rivals, bacon between album covers, head-scratching bacon)
The answer options laid out for the viewer to guess along (swatches, board, difficulty UI, albums, smiley sequence ending in '?')
Bright blue sky with cartoon clouds as the backdrop
IP characters as the bait

mechanic:rng_roll.art_style: Mixed. Bright simulator renders (about 6/12) sit alongside anime illustration (2-3/12) and dark/horror (2/12). No single style dominates the leaders; the NEW games are uniformly bright simulator.
avoid: Dark, logo-only art unless you can match established-brand polish
Dense lore text in the thumbnail
mechanic:rng_roll.direction: Icon: a bacon-hair avatar wrapped in a crackling coloured aura, holding up a glowing Mythic reward with a rainbow-outlined rarity tag above it. Thumbnail: a two-panel split from a dull first roll labelled '1' to a blazing Mythic reward labelled '999M', joined by a fat red curved arrow on a bright sky.
do: Show the jump in rarity, not just the odds: a split thumbnail with a low roll ('1') on the left, a red arrow, and a glowing Mythic reward with '$967Qa' on the right
Wrap the hero avatar in a coloured aura (lightning or fire glow) to signal a rare roll
If you use odds, run one rainbow-outlined '1 in 800,000,000' line across the top, not a paragraph
Use a bright saturated setting with a bacon-hair avatar; add a red 'YOU' arrow for the player-perspective hook
Keep a single glowing reward object (orb, weapon, creature) as the payoff focal point

icon_patterns.pattern: Bacon-hair or classic noob avatar as the subject
High-energy aura lighting: glowing auras, lightning, speed lines or fire behind the character (anime dice warrior, red Sol's beam, Anime Astral, VS face-off, planet orb)
Bright simulator setting (floating islands, ocean pier, treehouse/pagoda, pink candy path)
Overlay symbols: '+1' popups, 'NOW' + hourglass, or +1 flexing-arm icons

mechanic:rng_roll.newcomer_shift: All 4 NEW games (Aura Dance Battles, Chop Trees, Defend Your Treehouse, Roll Ice Cream) are bright bacon-hair simulator art. 3/4 thumbnails tell a before→after or 'this is you' story with red arrows and split panels. None shows '1 in X' odds: they show the escalating reward instead.
mechanic:rng_roll.summary: RNG roll leaders sell rarity through mood (anime aura art, '1 in X' odds, horror darkness, logos), while all NEW entrants switch to bright bacon-hair progression stories built from split panels and red arrows.
mechanic:rng_roll.text_usage: Leaders use logos and odds lines ('1 in X'). NEW games use progression labels ('Wave 1/15/99', '1' vs '999M', 'Mythic $967Qa'), 'YOU', 'VS' and the '6 7' meme in red outlined type.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Huge value or rarity number as the hook ('1 in 9,342,584', '1 in 800,000,000', 'MASSIVE ORCA $9,732,457,643/s', 'Mythic $967Qa')
Game logo in a corner (EVADE, Sol's RNG, Anime Astral, Threshold)
Dark, desaturated or monochrome drama (Sol's teal void, horror face in a tunnel, black-and-white slap with troll face)
Red arrows telling a progression or pointing at you (1 → 999M split, Wave 1 → 15 → 99 panels, 'YOU' arrow)

mechanic:tycoon_build.art_style: simulator_bright about 8/12; leaders use polished stylized renders.
mechanic:tycoon_build.direction: Icon: avatar carrying a glowing item toward a huge built base with a 'NEW' tag. Thumbnail: split panel, tiny $0.1 start vs giant upgraded base with $1M+ number.
do: Show a cheap start vs maxed end in a split
Put a big money number in the frame
Keep the avatar large in front of the base

icon_patterns.pattern: Avatar front and center with the base/vehicle behind
Bright saturated simulator colours
Logo or title text on icon

mechanic:tycoon_build.newcomer_shift: NEW tycoons show money splits ($0.1 vs $1.5M), offline-earnings banners and treasure-chest piles.
mechanic:tycoon_build.summary: Tycoons split between big brand-art leaders and newcomers selling growth: tiny-to-huge splits, money numbers and treasure piles.
mechanic:tycoon_build.text_usage: Leaders: logo. Newcomers: money numbers, 'YOU!', 'Drives offline', 'NEW'.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: Progression shown (level 1 to 6.5b, $0.1 to $1,542,848)
Big built structure (pyramid, mansion, store) behind avatar
